item.title: Pretty details! “Alicia”, Circa 1833 in Mississippi. $175,000
item.description: This house has a lot of pretty details! There is a lot of potential in this home. The house is known as “Alicia”. It was built in 1833. It is located on .49 acre in Holly Springs, Mississippi. The house features wrought iron fencing, brick walkway, a covered front porch, wood floors, picture rails, baseboards, crown moulding, french doors and built-ins. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,660 square feet. $175,000 Contact Stephanie Stroupe Jones with Welch Realty: 901-644-0349 From the Zillow list

item.title: Nice pond! Seven acres in North Carolina. Circa 1939. $399,900
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! It’s a really pretty area of North Carolina. The house was built in 1939. It is located on seven acres in Sparta, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, knotty pine and bead board. There is a pond, a stream and a couple of outbuildings on the property. I wish they had more and better pictures of the interior. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 1,980 square feet. $399,900 Contact Darlene Wyatt with Mountain Dreams Realty: 336-372-1

item.title: The view! Move in ready house! Circa 1890 in Virginia. $345,000
item.description: There is quite a view from this front porch! The house is move in ready! The home was built in 1890. It is located on .49 acre in Covington, Virginia. The house features a large covered front porch, nice kitchen, some wood floors, baseboards and updated bathrooms. There is a two car garage on the property. item.title: That stone fireplace! Diamond in the Rough! Four acres in Missouri. $100,000
item.description: That stone fireplace is so pretty! I like that whole room! This house looks like a diamond in the rough to me and it has some nice acreage. The house was built in 1943. It is located on 4.3 acres in Dittmer, Missouri. The house features knotty pine, exposed beams, large stone fireplace and some original wood floors. Outside there is a large back deck and an exterior fireplace. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,600 square feet. $100,000 Contact Laura M. Massey with EXP Realty: 314-691-2580 From

item.title: Great interior! That glass sunroom! That sink! C. 1900 in Montana. $445,000
item.description: Love this interior! That glass sunroom and the kitchen sink are perfect! This is known as the Samuel Russell House. It was built in 1900. The house is located in Virginia City, Montana. The house features a covered front porch, vaulted ceilings, exposed beams, wood floors, great kitchen sink, baseboards, french doors, glass sunroom and bead board. There is a detached storage building on the property. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,455 square feet. $445,000 Contact Toni Bowen with ERA Landmark

item.title: Rustic, but nice! Over two acres in New Jersey. $149,900
item.description: This house is rustic, but it has some nice details! It could definitely use some lightening up inside. The house was built in 1935. It is located on 2.28 acres in Branchville, New Jersey. The house features vaulted ceiling, wood floors, log walls, built-ins and exposed beams. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 848 square feet. $149,900 Contact Danielle Conklin with Kistle Realty: 973-250-3299 From the Zillow listing: Charming Rustic Log Cabin with 2 bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms. item.description: This house has a pretty setting! Nice acreage too! I love the long driveway. This is known as Stonewall Farm. The house was built in 1820. It is located on 20.7 acres in Highland, New York. The house features wood floors, a lot of natural light, baseboards, a built-in corner cabinet, updated kitchen and a great screened in porch. There is a large detached garage on the property and a long driveway. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,244 square feet. $639,000 Contact Hayes Clement with Compass Gr

item.title: Nice woodwork! Attached greenhouse! One acre in Ohio. $250,000
item.description: This house has some nice woodwork! The attached greenhouse could be nice! The house was built in 1875. it is located on one acre in Danville, Ohio. The house features a covered front porch, unique door casements, original mantels, wood floors, pocket doors and a large attached greenhouse. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,342 square feet. $250,000 Contact Sam Miller with Re/Max Stars From the Zillow listing: Gorgeous historical country home that is filled with charm and character throughout and

item.title: Privacy and potential! Over six acres near the Blue Ridge Parkway in Virginia. $159,900
item.description: This house has privacy and potential! This is a pretty area near the Blue Ridge Parkway! Nice acreage considering the price! The house was built in 1930. It is located on 6.51 acres in Hillsville, Virginia. The house could use a good cleaning out so you can really see what is there as far as details.
